scene mayainvdorm1
So of course that unfaithfulness ultimately led me here — to the wrong side of something familiar. Just a step or two away from another instance of impulse disguised as fate.
I don’t like her smile. I don’t like how her flesh is still warm when it should feel like porcelain. I don’t like that ribbon. I don’t like her eyes. How she doesn’t blink as much as she’s meant to.
I love it.
And that’s far worse and far heavier than any amount of disdain, understandable or not, could ever be.
: So, assuming your dreadful niece hasn’t left another package for me to deliver, would you like to come inside and continue our date?
: Daughter.
scene mayainvdorm2
: Fine. I can roleplay.
: No, Maya. I meant that Ami is my daughter now. I don’t want you-
: I know exactly what you meant. That’s why I tried to swiftly move past it with the offer of a charade you can’t possibly refuse.
: Just, I can refuse.
scene mayainvdorm3
: Can you...Daddy?
scene mayainvdorm4
: Don’t just ignore me, Daddy. I’ve waited all day for you to come home. And I’ve been so lonely. Maybe we could-
: Okay, fine. You win. I can’t refuse that. But I can’t refuse you in general, so...this was unfair from the start.
scene mayainvdorm5
: You refuse me plenty. It’s actually quite annoying. You never used to be like that.
: It used to be like, “Hi, Maya. Sex?” And then I’d be like, “Indeed.” Then three minutes later I’d be all sticky and gross and need to take a shower.
: Three minutes? Really?
scene mayainvdorm6
: Realistically, it’s probably closer to two. I just decided to include the extra sixty seconds of you hovering above me once you’ve finished to make you feel better about yourself.
: How kind of you...
scene mayainvdorm1
: Are you coming in or not?
: Because I may not have a tree for you to fuck me up against, but I do have all of those costumes I alluded to earlier which I will gladly let you choose from.
scene mayainvdorm7
: Or I guess I can just act disinterested since that seems to turn you on better than anything nowadays. You’re disgusting.
: Okay, you win. Hi, Maya. Sex?
scene mayainvdorm8
: I suppose I can indulge your perverted desires if it means making you slightly less incorrigible in the near future.
: I think you were supposed to just say “indeed.”
: And I think you should be spending more time with girls you wouldn’t get arrested for merely looking at.
scene black
: Alas — my bad luck must continue and I must now spread my legs for what I can only imagine is-
: You don’t need to imagine anything, Maya. You know exactly how big my-
scene mayainvdorm9
: Hi, Aki-kun! Long time, no see.
: Ami...
: How big your what is, Dad?
: Uhh...hi...Ami...
: I...didn’t really expect you to...be here.
scene mayainvdorm10
: Yeah, well, I was tired of listening to you fuck Niki’s brains out every night. So I figured I’d come spend the night here to give myself a break from all of that.
scene mayainvdorm11
: Oh, and Maya’s here too. Sorry if that was a little abrasive.
scene mayainvdorm12
: Why...are you here?
: Hm? Because we share this dorm room, silly.
: Yes. But you specifically told me earlier that you would not be here tonight. You know, like how you’re never here at all anymore.
: To be completely fair, Maya, it should have been a dead giveaway that I would show up when I went out of my way to tell you I wouldn’t. Since that’s been the norm and all.
scene mayainvdorm13
: Yeah! Maybe if you didn’t also fucking tell me that the reason I had to do your stupid, box-based chores was because you were busy!
scene mayainvdorm14
: Oh yeah. I did say that, didn’t I? Wow. Maybe I am the bad guy here after all then?
: You think?!
: Ew — Aki-kun, you’re not planning on fucking that...thing you dragged in, are you? I taught you better than that.
scene mayainvdorm15
: Oh, right. If you talk to me with Ami around, she might lash out. Good thinking, Aki-kun.
: But seriously though, are you really gonna fuck that thing?
: Sorry — were you guys planning on having sex tonight?
scene mayainvdorm16
: Oh, yay! She’s just like me!
scene mayainvdorm17
: If we were, would that be a problem?
: I figure letting me fuck your dad is the least you can do since you’re going to make me do all sorts of shit now, Ami. That sounds fair, right?
: Oh, yay! You think I’m his daughter again. I could have sworn I heard you call me his niece just a minute ago. But yeah! Go for it.
: Yeah, I didn’t think-
scene mayainvdorm18
: Wait, really?
: Yeah. I won’t get in the way. I’ll probably touch myself, though. But only if you guys are okay with that.
scene mayainvdorm19
: I mean...I won’t say I’m against it...
: On second thought...I should probably just...go.
scene mayainvdorm20
: But...things were going so well! And you said it yourself that you would try and spend more time with me! Don’t let Ami’s fucking...creepiness get in the way of that!
: Hey! My creepiness has been mostly unobtrusive lately! I take offense to that!
scene mayainvdorm21
: Unobtrusive?! That’s what you call it?! Getting in the way of my personal life just to fuck with me?! Because that sounds pretty obtrusive to me, Ami!
scene mayainvdorm22
: Again — why does it have to be so nasty?
: I’m not getting in the way of anything, though. I just said you guys can go at it and I won’t interfere. I’ll just masturbate.
: Which is probably what I was going to do tonight anyway since I could smell that my dad was in the hall at some point and it turned me on.
scene mayainvdorm23
: I’ll be more than happy to join in if you’ll let me, though! I’ve just never touched a girl before, so forgive me if I do anything wrong.
: Sensei-
scene mayainvdorm24
: Rain check, Maya. I’m just...not in the mood for this anymore.
: Wait! I’ll come with you! I don’t-
: Just...rain check. Okay?
: Hah...alone again. Being dead is so depressing sometimes.
: Aww, man. I was really looking forward to watching you guys.
: I can only imagine how intense the sex is if the sheer desire for it can give you strength even when the world around you is tearing into pieces.
scene mayainvdorm25
: I’M FUCKING TIRED OF THIS, AMI! JUST TELL ME WHAT YOU WANT FROM ME! STOP TREATING ME LIKE YOUR FUCKING PUPPET!
: You’re not a puppet, you’re a doll. Dolls are much cuter.
: JUST FUCKING LEAVE ME ALONE! I WANT TO LIVE MY LIFE! I WANT TO BE WITH SENSEI! AND I FINALLY HAD ANOTHER CHANCE TONIGHT AND YOU-
: Enabled it?
scene mayainvdorm26
: ...What?
: Well...think about it. If I don’t tell you to dispose of that box, Sensei’s never rocked by his emotional connection to it.
: Then the two of you don’t use the rest of the night to start repairing the broken bridge that is your relationship and go eat takoyaki and stuff.
: How do you know about the takoyaki?
scene mayainvdorm27
: Oh, that’s easy. Sensei isn’t good with technology, so I turned the “find my phone” feature on when I was helping him update his one night and then linked it to my phone.
: Now I can see where he is at all times and don’t have to worry anymore!
: Smart, right? Anyway, how was dinner?
: You’re...keeping track of where he is?
scene mayainvdorm28
: I feel like that’s actually one of the less crazy things I’ve done. Just wait until you find out what I’ve put in his food.
: So is he your doll too then?! Or is he a puppet?! And what about everyone else?! Who do you want control of next?!
scene mayainvdorm29
: Ayane would be nice. She keeps surprising me. Which is pretty weird given how long I’ve been doing this.
: Here’s a new idea! Why don’t you just leave all of us alone?! I won’t let you torment me into keeping your fucking...reality-breaking secret anymore!
scene mayainvdorm30
: I can tell based on how loud you’re being right now. I implore you to reconsider, though. At least if you want to keep thinking you’re actually alive or whatever.
: I am alive, though! I have feelings! I’m in love! I have needs and wants and connections and you’re trampling all over them by hanging your fucking...powers over my head!
: I don’t have powers. How many times do I have to tell you this?
scene mayainvdorm31
: Well, until someone else figures out how to pull me through different layers of reality or...timelines or...whatever that was, I’m going to keep assuming you do.
: But I’m not going to let the fear of that threaten me anymore. And I’m not going to keep doing your bidding just because I’m afraid of you.
: Is it just me or is this a bit of an overreaction to just being in the room while you want to fuck my dad?
scene mayainvdorm32
: It’s more than that and you know it...
: You’re supposed to be my best friend. We’re supposed to be in this together.
: But instead, you keep treating me like a pet you’ve locked in a cage. One you only take out when you want to trick yourself into thinking you can ever care for anything.
: When, in all actuality, you’re just neglectful. You don’t actually care about the things you look after. You care about feeling like you’re doing something good. But you’re not.
: You hurt everyone by just fucking existing. You are nothing like the Ami I know. Because the Ami I know wouldn’t ever hurt me on purpose.
: And you do it just for fun.
: Feel better?
: Not really. No.
scene mayainvdorm33
: Then why don’t you tell me what I can do to make up for how apparently horrible I am to you? Want me to go get the shackles again?
: You can’t do anything. But I can.
scene mayainvdorm34
: Oh? And what are you going to do then?
: Ever since Halloween...I’ve been keeping your secret because I’ve been afraid of what you’ll do to me if I don’t. But that’s not going to get me anywhere.
: You’re going to tell Sensei then? That I’m a super-secret time traveling villain and not just a normal girl?
: You gonna leave in the part where I made you cum your brains out too? Or does that one get to stay secret since it makes you look like a filthy whore?
: I’ll tell him everything...that part too.
scene mayainvdorm35
: Right. But, just out of curiosity, what exactly do you think this is going to accomplish?
: Do you expect me to just play nice once I’m dragged into this mess with you guys?  That I’ll stop being clingy and needy? What’s the end game here?
: I don’t expect any of that...but I expect he’ll stop giving you everything you want just because your mom died.
: Sensei doesn’t give me everything I want because my mom died. He gives me everything I want because he loves me.
: And if you tell him I know more than he thinks I know, do you know what’ll really happen, Maya?
: He’ll leave every single one of you. Just like he’d have done for the last girl who lived inside of that skin. He’ll leave you and he’ll be with me. Just me. For the rest of time.
: Don’t play games with me, Ami. If that were true, you’d have fucking told him yourself. You wouldn’t turn down a world where it’s just you and him and you know it.
: You’re right. That would be my perfect world. And it’s exactly what I want. But you’re making me sound worse than I am again.
scene mayainvdorm36
: If Sensei finds out I’ve known what’s been going on this whole time, do you have any idea how much he’ll suffer?
: Do you have any idea how terrible he’ll feel knowing I’ve had to look after myself this whole time while he refuses to come to grips with who he really is to me?
: Do you really think that what the two of you share is stronger than that? Or do you think that maybe, deep down, what he wants is more than just sex?
scene mayainvdorm37
: He wants to be happy. He wants a family. He wants a normal life in a normal world where he doesn’t have to deal with mistakes like you.
: That is why I haven’t told him. Because, unlike you, I don’t want to hurt him. And I won’t make him suffer just so things will be easier for me.
: At least...not on a long-term basis.
: I’m not a bad person, Maya. I just do a lot of bad things.
scene mayainvdorm38
: Which, of course, means that I have no problem deleting you if you’re going to put his wellbeing in jeopardy like you say you are.
: D...Deleting?...
: Words like “kill” are too heavy and dramatic to be wasted on those who have never been alive to begin with.
: And while I can’t reset you myself, I can sure find a way to make you wish I could.
: Now, if you’re done with your little temper tantrum, do you want to watch a movie together or something?
: A...movie?...
: But we...but I...
scene mayainvdorm39
: You let your emotions get in the way of what needs to be done.
: You can’t let that happen here.
: I can teach you how to properly exist in this place, but not if you question me.
: So just...do as you say? No questions asked?...
: I’m supposed to just...agree to that? And let you keep trampling all over the things I want? The things that make me happy?
: It’s easier than you make it sound.
scene black
: Just want fewer things.
